high_level_description: The image depicts a rocket launch against a clear blue sky with some scattered clouds. The rocket is prominently featured in the center of the image, with its engines ignited and emitting a bright flame and plume of smoke. The rocket has a sleek design with a pointed nose cone at the top and a cylindrical body that appears to be segmented, with different colored sections, including white, red, and black. Below the rocket, there is text in bold yellow letters that reads "TRENDING." Underneath, in smaller white text, it states: "ROCKET LAB WINS $515 MILLION CONTRACT TO BUILD 18
